messages:
elena_cs: Quick sync — Verdant Labs renewal. Procurement pushed back: they want monthly billing + a 9‑month term instead of annual. CFO says monthly only if we accept a 9mo. They also need vendor code and PO flow. Need pricing signoff + legal on 9mo amendment. @tom_am can you confirm pricing impact?

tom_am: Pricing quick take — 9mo term usually gets a modest discount. Thinking ~95% of ARR pro‑rated across 9 months? cc @nick_fin for finance constraints.

nick_fin: Finance view: monthly is extra ops work. Preference = annual upfront or 9mo paid upfront. If they insist monthly, we need net30 on a PO or card on file. Also need W‑9 for our records.

olivia_ops: Ops note — we need vendor code + billing contact before provisioning. If they want Dedicated, we'll need KMS contact and SOC2 org id. PO must include vendor code & billing email to automate provisioning.

andrew-verdant: From Verdant procurement: they can do 9mo but only with monthly invoices. They cannot approve annual upfront. Can you confirm invoice format and SOW amendment? Procurement needs DocuSign friendly attachments.

elena_cs: Thanks Andrew. @sarah_legal can you review a 9mo amendment + SOW update and confirm if we can accept monthly billing in contract?

sarah_legal: I can take this. High level: 9mo term is acceptable as an amendment. We should add a 30‑day notice termination clause and payment default language. Esign is fine. I'll prepare a redline and call out any holdback language.

tom_am: Pricing team okay with 9mo @ 95% (no upfront holdback) unless legal flags credit risk. Recommend we include auto‑renew to annual after the 9mo unless either party opts out.

nick_fin: Operational reqs if we accept monthly: PO number each month or card on file + billing contact. VAT/tax handling also needs to be documented on the PO.

olivia_ops: Ops checklist for provisioning: vendor code, PO number (or card), billing email, KMS admin contact, and VPC subnet (if private). Send all to ops@redwood.com when ready.

andrew-verdant: I'll push procurement for card on file, but worst case they will issue monthly POs. ETA for their procurement reply: EOD Tuesday. We also have W‑9 ready to attach.

elena_cs: I'll draft the SOW amendment and share via DocSend. @docsend-bot please upload once draft is ready.

docsend-bot: Upload link: https://docsend.com/s/verdant-renewal-9mo-v1

tom_am: Noted — if procurement insists on monthly, I'll flag renewal risk in SFDC: renewal-risk-high and tag AM for follow up.

sarah_legal: Redline uploaded to SharePoint: https://redwood.sharepoint/verdant_redline. Key changes: payment default clause, termination notice, data deletion at end‑of‑term, clause about invoices being payable net30.

nick_fin: Once we have PO or card + W‑9, finance will set up net30 and schedule monthly invoices. Please route PO copies to billing@redwood.com.

andrew-verdant: Confirmed — procurement will attach W‑9 and vendor code to the first PO. I will send the PO to billing@redwood.com and ops@redwood.com.

olivia_ops: :thumbsup: Ops ready to onboard after PO + vendor code received. Reconvene after we have DocSend sign and procurement reply.

elena_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate next steps into the SFDC renewal task and follow up after procurement reply.
